description: Drainage - Network Structures is a dataset listed in Pierce County open data portal (internal.open.piercecountywa.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by Pierce County. GPS'd storm water point features in unincorporated Pierce County that manage a volume of water for flow control or treatment, such as a detention vault, vault mechanical filter, etc. Includes public and private features except where private gates prevent access. Please read metadata ( for additional information. Coverage: Pierce County, Washington. The portal files it under the category Maps and Geospatial. Its tags are drainage, network structure. The table has 50 columns. The portal shows 2026-07-02 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support urban drainage and flood-risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-internal-open-piercecountywa-gov-portal.
